page_title: VIL 2-3 SEV | Villarreal v Sevilla 13/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Mateo Busquets is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Villarreal comes to nothing.
90+3' The referee is firm and issues Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) a deserved yellow card.

90+2' Renato Veiga (Villarreal) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mateo Busquets had an easy-decision to make. Sevilla have been awarded a free kick from long distance, it won't be a direct shot.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Villarreal have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
86' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to make a change. Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) replaces Djibril Sow.
86' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Akor Adams as he is replaced by Castrin (Sevilla).
85' Pau Navarro (Villarreal) collects the ball from the corner kick and aims towards the left side of the goal. However, his mid-range effort is brilliantly blocked by the defending player.
84' The linesman makes the right call and Villarreal will have a corner.
81' The game has begun to heat up. Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
78' Pau Navarro (Villarreal) makes a rough challenge and Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for a foul.
76' Villarreal fail to score from a corner as Odysseas Vlachodimos (Sevilla) leaps to collect the ball.
75' The Villarreal players are exchanging some short passes.
72' 2 - 3 Goal - 2:3! Djibril Sow laid the ball off to Akor Adams (Sevilla), who shot from close range into the top left corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
72' That will be all from Neal Maupay who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla).
70' Marcelino decides to make a substitution. Dani Parejo will be replaced by Santi Comesana (Villarreal).
70' Marcelino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) replacing Georges Mikautadze.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) will replace Ruben Vargas.
66' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.
64' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
63' Neal Maupay (Sevilla) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the roof of the net, but Arnau Tenas was alert and the score remains the same.
60' Here is a change. Pape Gueye is going off and Marcelino gives the last tactical orders to Thomas Partey (Villarreal).
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) comes onto the pitch for Nicolas Pepe.
60' Akor Adams (Sevilla) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
58' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is behind the touchline and Sevilla will take a throw-in.
55' The resulting set piece from Sevilla is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
53' The attendance for today's match is 17325.
51' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Villarreal, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

50' The game is interrupted. Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. It's a free kick to Villarreal, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
49' The corner is swung in but Sevilla can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
48' Oso (Sevilla) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Now Sevilla have a corner.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' 2 - 2 What a goal! Ruben Vargas plays it to Kike Salas (Sevilla), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Arnau Tenas into the roof of the net. 2:2.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.

44' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
43' Kike Salas (Sevilla) connects well with the free kick, but heads the ball just over the bar from close in. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
42' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) commits a rough foul. Mateo Busquets stops the game and makes a call. Sevilla will take a free kick near the side line.
41' Sevilla work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

40' Neal Maupay (Sevilla) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The ball is out of play. Sevilla will have a chance to score from a corner.
37' Mateo Busquets has a clear sight and sees a foul from Akor Adams (Sevilla).
36' 2 - 1 Oso (Sevilla) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Arnau Tenas with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:1.
34' Oso (Sevilla) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
32' Sevilla can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
31' Neal Maupay (Sevilla) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
29' Neat passing move from Sevilla in order to create new attacking opportunities.
27' Oso (Sevilla) gets in a promising position inside the box after a rebound, but his resulting header to the middle of the target is too weak and the goalkeeper saves it easily.
25' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) commits a rough challenge and Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for an infringement.
24' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Villarreal.
20' 2 - 0 Goal! Alberto Moleiro passes the ball to the feet of Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 2:0.
18' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
15' Oso (Sevilla) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.

13' 1 - 0 Goal! Georges Mikautadze slips a clever pass through to Gerard Moreno (Villarreal), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
12' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
10' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) bursts into the box and latches on to a pin-point long through ball, but one of the defenders steps in to clear the ball to safety.
9' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
5' The referee blows his whistle after Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
3' A cross from a corner kick by Villarreal is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

3' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Villarreal.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Sevilla will kick the game off.
Mateo Busquets is introduced as the referee for today's match.
